lineage.v2_frozen_conclusion: v2 fixed the cancel policy clock and request-conditioned ACK structure; pre-request fill and ACK are Development-supported side-role aggregate building blocks only; 298 pending fills are an extremely sparse nuisance; the complete learned three-phase family closed on Development

source_identity.reuse_contract: reuse hash-verified C++ lifecycle and request-state caches; do not replay raw L2 for this statistical family

panels.outer_folds: reuse the six frozen expanding chronological v2 folds and their 29 OOF test days

estimand.operational_probability: P(activation | action,x0) times the conditional active-order fill CIF
estimand.gtx_reject: separate activation and operational outcome; never enter conditional fill monotonicity

component_contract.pre_request_fill: reuse frozen v2 chronological OOF predictions; reassess calibration and proper score separately for each action
component_contract.conditional_ack: reuse frozen v2 chronological OOF predictions; reassess calibration and residual sufficiency separately for each action
component_contract.pending_fill: replace the rejected learned head with a past-only hierarchical Beta-Binomial nuisance
component_contract.joint_brier: diagnostic only and explicitly labelled ACK-dominated; never evidence for pending-fill predictability

pending_hierarchy.side_prior: outer-base-train empirical rate with Jeffreys 0.5/0.5 stabilization
pending_hierarchy.request_reason_diagnostic: side x action x request_reason posterior centered on side-action parent
pending_hierarchy.role_diagnostic: side x action x role posterior centered on side-action parent

report_horizons_ms.provenance: frozen v2 first-outer-base-train p25/p50/p75 durations; reporting cuts only

action_specific_gate.unit: side x role x action x complete component curve
action_specific_gate.proper_score: day-clustered Brier-improvement 95% lower bound above zero versus the frozen v2 side-role-action exposure-only baseline

common_support_monotonicity.eligible_cohort: all three actions activated successfully, share the same market path and use identical lifecycle rules

residual_sufficiency_audit.purpose: model sufficiency only; does not identify or prove conditional independence of latent T_fill and T_ACK
residual_sufficiency_audit.ack_audit: day-clustered observed-minus-expected in supported low/high state tails
residual_sufficiency_audit.pending_audit: 99% Beta-Binomial posterior-predictive coverage; no latent dependence claim
residual_sufficiency_audit.multiplicity: Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided 95% day-cluster intervals across supported ACK tail cells

pending_ev_uncertainty.formula: one-sided posterior probability uncertainty times request remaining notional times stress bps
pending_ev_uncertainty.reference_provenance: one BTCUSDC execution tick 0.1 USDC/BTC times standard 0.001 BTC order
